translations.web: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
translations.bsb: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
translations.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
translations.asv: And he that hath seen hath borne witness, and his witness is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye also may believe.
